tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// edhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bdag 'jug 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga ni/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos grub rin chen mi zad gter// rdo rje rnal 'byor mar btud nas// de yi byin rlabs rgya mtsho yi// 'byor pa bya phyir 'dir bshad bya// chos kyi tshul 'di la zhugs shing*// 'di nyid bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag gis byin rlabs dngos grub don du gnyer bas/ dus bzang po la gnas dben zhing yid du 'ong bar dri bzang po dang ba byung gis byugs pa'i sa gzhi tshon dmar pos yongs su bsgyur ba la/ re khā dkar pos phyi'i mu khyud dang bcas pa'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris pa'i steng du ka pā la bdud rtsi sbyar pa'i chang gis yongs su bkang ba bzhag nas/ de'i steng du sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dpe ris bzhin gser gyi myu gus bris pa'i dbus su dri ma med pa'i ting lo chung bar dar ram lwa ba dmar po la sogs pa'i dar khang mdzes par phub pa'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ shin tu zhim pa'i bza' ba dang*/ btung ba dang 'bru la sogs pas yongs su bskor zhing gtor ma gsum dang*/ nang mchod la sogs pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs bzhin bshams la/ gzungs thag gis dkris pa'i rdo rje dang dung chos dang bcas pa'i bum pa bcud rnams kyis gang ba gcig kyang bshams la/ zhu ba dbul ba nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo ltar bya'o// de nas sum+bha ni'i sngags brjod cing nang mchod kyis sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal la gtor te bsangs nas/ swa bhā was stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ lam̐ las sa/ sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du kam̐ las thod pa dkar po shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du/

pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su e yig nyis brtsegs las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas nyis brtsegs khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags kyi yi ge dmigs pa rnams las 'od zer phar 'phros/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed nas go cha dgod pa dang*/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma dbul ba'i bar tshogs 'khor gyi skabs bzhin bya'o// de nas bum pa sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba bcings shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa gnyis bskyed pa'i nang du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas nas gzungs thags la bzung ste/ sngags gzungs thags la brten nas bum pa'i nang du song bas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rgyud bskul nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun zag pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ rje btsun ma'i sngags gang 'grub dang*/ sum+bha ni gang 'grub/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shri hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs par bzlas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod de/ dung chos kyi chu blugs pas lha'i chu sku yang 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bsdad la/

bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba bdag la rtse gcig tu dgongs pa mngon sum ltar dmigs la/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon nyid la bdag skyabs mchi// dpa' ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mdzad par bsams la/ gdong g.yogs bcings/ me tog phreng ba blangs/ bum pa'i chus bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ nang mchod myong bas/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing byin gyis rlabs par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor bsam nas/ rje btsun mas snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ gsang bar gdams pa mdzad par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta ya mī su ra te sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma bzhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes brjod do// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du bcug par bsam la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su bzlo bar bsam zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sdom pa bzung ba dang*/

dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa yang lan gsum brjod cing blang ngo*// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang zhing khyab pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas/ 'od 'dus pas lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du bam̐ gyi yi ge sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba gcig tu gyur na/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la phog pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhig tu gyur/ 'od tshur 'dus te rang la thim pas rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ 'od tshur 'dus te rang la thim pas rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas/ go cha bcings pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la/ slob dpon khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rnams stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi ting lo spar la de rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs dang ye shes thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa de nyid kyi thugs kar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad dang mnyam par gyur pa/ rje btsun ma nyid kyis bdag gis khar bcug par bsam zhing*/ mid pas/ mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song ba lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ dang 'dres pa las byung ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsal bar bskyed la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bar mdzad/ nang gi chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang*/ phyi'i lha mo'i smin mtshams kyi thad ka rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po g.yon phyogs su myur bar 'khor bar bsam mo// de'i tshe mdun gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sngags kyi sgra drag tu bsgrags pas/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par gyur nas bdag la thim pas bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ sgrub pa'i grogs rnams kyis gu gul dud pa dang rol mo'i sgra byed du gzhug go /de nas rje btsun mas bdag gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje bzhag nas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par byas par bsam/ ye shes dbab pa las byung ba'i nyams myong ma brjed par bskyangs/ de nas me tog phreng ba rje btsun ma'i thugs kar 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod nas maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su 'bul/ phreng ba'i sngags kyis phreng bar byin gyis rlabs nas/ rje btsun mas bdag gi spyi bor bzhag par bsam la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa staṃ i maṃ sa twa mahā pa la oṃ/ zhes gsungs par bsam zhing spyi bor blangs/ de nas oṃ ne tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes gsungs shing gdong g.yogs phye nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bsam nas dngos su blta'o 'jug pa'o// de nas dbang blangs pa'i phyir/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang skur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar mkha' spyod ma dpal gtso// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng mdzod cig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur dmigs pa'i mdun gyi rin po che'i khri'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs pa'i steng du gdugs dang*/ sa dang nam mkha' thams cad mchod pas gang bas bdag la mchod par bsam/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha 'phros pas so sos dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad/ khyad par lha mo nyid rigs lnga dang bcas pas rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bas spyi bo nas blug cing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang skur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

tsakra bi ra staṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes mgrin gcig tu gsungs shing*/ dbang skur bar bsam spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad gang dri ma dag dbang thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par bya'o// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes gsungs par bsam zhing*/ me tog gtor nas rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur bsam mo// de nas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bgrang phreng bzung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas bdag nyid kyi snying ga'i bam̐ gyi mtha' mar g.yon skor du bkod pas rje btsun ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs bdag la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ gsang sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas phreng ba nyid sngags kyi ngo bor byin gyis rlabs te spyi bor bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum gsungs nas/ sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba byin par bsam mo// de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon blangs la/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du byugs pas sku'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par bsgom zhing*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob snyam du bsam mo// bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar maṇ+ḍal gyi thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas/ rje btsun ma nyid kyis bdag gis khar sbyin par bsam zhing*/ dngos su 'thung bas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas yang g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon blangs te/ rang gi gsang gnas dang*/ lte ba dang*/ snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ skra mtshams rnams su reg pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le bdag gi bha ga nas zhugs nas lus thams cad khyab pas rim pa bzhin ye shes kyi dga' ba bzhi skyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam mo// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma dag /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ngo sprad nas/ rang nyid kyis stong pa nyid kyi ngang las sems mnyam par bzhag go /de nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob snyam du bsams nas/ dbang thams cad gnang ba'i bka' drin gyi lan du/ lus ngag longs spyod thams cad yid kyis dbul la/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams byin gyis rlabs nas tshogs la longs spyod pa dang*/ gshegs su gsol nas/ bdag nyid bsrung ba'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzhin bya'o// bye brag tu sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ sin+dhu ra za ma tog la sogs par legs par bzung la phyis rdul tshon la bsre bar bya'o// tshul de ltar rtag tu byas na sdig pa dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing*/ tshe dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob ste/

dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs nas myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// mkha' spyod dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag nyid zhugs nas dbang blang ba'i// tshul 'di zab mo'i snying po ste// gsang ba las kyang gsang ba yin// de ltar mod kyi tshul 'di la// dad cing shes rab dran gsal ba// go go can gyis gsol btab nas// sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// mkha' la spyod pa'i dbang thob nas// gnyis su med par rol par shog /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa blangs pa'i cho ga 'di ni lcags pho rta'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin shangs mdo'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /edhi/

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs kyi yi ge rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lus pa'i// bsdu dang spro ba'i gtsor gyur ma// mkha' spyod ma dpal gnyis med pa'i// mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud// gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba// mkha' spyod ma dpal dkyil 'khor du// bdag nyid 'jug dang slob ma la// dbang skur cho ga bri bar bya// de la gang gis 'jug pa'i rten gyi gang zag dang*/ gang la 'jug pa'i cho ga'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam smin grol gnyis las/ phyi'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob nas/ dam tshig gi tshogs la legs par gnas pa/ grol lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod nas/ rgyun gyi nyams len gnad du dril nas bsgom pa gcig gis/ 'di'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba thob nas/ nyams len chags med kyi ngang nas 'di'i bsnyen sgrub legs par song ba/ khyad par gzhan don du slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i sngon du kha gso ba'i bsnyen sgrub byas nas gnang ba thob pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la sbyor ba dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum mo// dang po la gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ dus tshes bcu gnyis gang yang rung ba la ji ltar 'os par byi dor bya/ 'thas shing mnyam pa'i gzhir ba byung lnga'am dri bzang gis byugs/ mtho gang sogs tshad kyi zlum skor bya/ sor phyed tsam phyir bskyed/ zlum skor dang mthun par gnyis las/ nang gi zlum skor dang mthun par chos 'byung gnyis kyi thig gdab/ de nas chos 'byung gnyis tshon dmar po/ thig gi gcod mtshams re khā dkar po/ nang gi zlum skor dang chos 'byung gi bar khyams rnams ljang gu/ zlum skor gnyis ka'i re khā dkar po/ bar gyi mu khyud sngon po bri/ de nas mtho gang la sogs pa maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/

sngon nas tshon dmar po byugs pa'i steng du sin+dhu ra khod snyoms par brdal/ gser gyi thur ma'am/ med na rdo rje'i rtse mos/ zlum po dang po dang mthun par chos 'byung gru gsum bris pa'i dbus su bam̐ bris pa'i mthar/ mdun nas g.yon skor gyis oṃ gsum ma oṃ oṃ oṃ dang*/ sarba dang*/ bud+dha dang*/ ḍā ki dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ war+ṇa dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ bai ro dang*/ rtsa nī ye dang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang*/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dang*/ swā hā rnams rim bzhin/ de yang shar drang por oṃ/ byang du ḍā/ nub tu ṇā/ lhor nī byung na legs/ mgo phyir bstan bris/ mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re bris/ de nas sngar gyi chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi steng du mañji btsugs pa'i steng du/ bur chang ngam/ sbrang chang ngam/ chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pas bkang ba'i thod pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa bzhag de nyid kyi khar dar dmar ram/ lwa dmar ram/ ras dmar pos bcad/ de'i steng du sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhag dar dmar ram/ lwa dmar ram/ ras dmar khru gang gi gur la sogs pa phub/ de'i khor ra khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod bde mchog phyi mchod ltar legs par bsham mo// phyag bzhes la lnga tshar bde mchog phyi mchod ltar bsham mo// ting lo sdong bu can gyi phyag len la/ zan gtsang ma'i ril bu chung ngu sdong bu gtsugs nas slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du mdun du bzhag gzhan gdong g.yogs dmar po dang me tog gi phreng ba slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa bsham mo// 'thor ba'i me tog kyang bsham mo// slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa bcud dang ldan pa dang*/ khyad par mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan dung chos rdor gzungs rnams bde mchog ltar bsham mo// rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du rdor dril nang mchod dang bcas pa bsham/ de dag cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// gtogs pa'i sbyor ba la tshogs yod na slob mas maṇ+ḍal sngon du btang nas zhu 'bul bya/

de nas slob dpon gyi thugs dam la bskul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i he ru ka'i bsgom bzlas kyi rgyud sbyangs/ bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya/ 'di ni shin tu gal che bas sngar bshad pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa ltar nges shes bskyed dgos so// 'di nang mchod rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang yang rung bas skabs dang sbyar nas byin gyis brlabs/ mañji'i steng gi thod pa yang de ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gsum sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ sum̐ las ri rab kyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad mda'i drwa ba dang*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su zhes rgyas par ram/ yang na 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i nang gi dbus su zhes rgyas bsdus gnyis skabs dang sbyar ba'o// kam̐ las thod pa bskyed pa mi mdzad/ rgyu mtshan ngag las shes dgos so// yang e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar oṃ gsum mas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje phag mo sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can ma/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug kha thur du 'phyang ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ste/ zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang ba dan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha= gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo nas/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa du kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin no// slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod dam ma mchod na'ang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī ye hūm̐/ tsakra bi ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ spros pa la dga' na rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mchod pa'i zhing du oṃ badz+ra= bde mchog ltar mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi ni sngon du song ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/

gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇī'i bar ting nge 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas legs par mchod/ spros pa la dga' na sngar gyi sngags sngon song gi rū pa ka ma gu na sogs 'dod yon lnga ting nge 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod pa ni phyi'i mchod pa'o// nang mchod byin brlabs rgyas par byas la/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon dril bu pa/ ḍaiṃ gi pa/ an+dhar pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa ring brgyud do// nye brgyud la rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dpal nā ro ta pa/ 'di man chad gnyis 'dra/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ bral phug pa bsod nams dpal/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du 'bru gsum gyis dbul lo// gzhan yang chos kyi bka' drin mnos pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ gsum mas/ yi dam gyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du= gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du= rang gi lce rtse/ mgrin pa/ dpral ba/ snying ga rnams su 'bru gsum gyis reg pas/ lus dkyil lam phung khams skye mched lha'i ngo bo bsams la bde bas tshim par bsgom/ de nas chos skyong mgon po lcam dral/ ye shes kyi mgon po gdong bzhi pa/ las mgon rnams kyi sngags la 'bru gsum btags la dbul/ de nas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje= pad+ma= rin chen= las kyi ste sde lnga'i tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du=

gzhan yang yul nyer bzhi/ gnas so gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i sprul sku'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'di man rigs drug gi bar bde mchog ltar ro// rang gi lce la bzhag pas gsung rdo rje mnyes par bsam/ de nas yid 'byung gi mchod pa bde mchog ltar rgyas par bya/ de nas bstod pa ni yum gyi rkang brgyad skabs su babs pas bya/ gzhan gang shes kyi bstod/ gtor ma 'dir bsngo ba'am/ bdag 'jug gi rjes su bsngo ba gnyis las tshogs dang 'brel na 'og tu bsngo ba bde'o// de nas bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du bhūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa bde mchog ltar bskyed/ nang chu dang bcud kyis gang ba'i dbus su e las rigs bdag gi bar du mdun bskyed ltar bskyed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sngon song gi nyer spyod lnga/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi dang*/ de sngon song gi nang mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// zhes tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod/ de nas dmigs pa bde mchog dang 'dra/ oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi pa/ a bhi ṣe ka ta ji ltar rigs pas nyer gcig yan bzla/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas bdag dang sems can thams cad mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ yig brgya gsum bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ dung chos kyi mchod yon phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bum dbang gi lha zhu ba las bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod do// de nas bdag 'jug la mdun bskyed kyi gtso mo dang bla ma gnyis su med pa la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum ltar dmigs la/

de thams cad dgongs pa rtse gcig pas bdag la dgongs pa/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi mtshams sbyor gyi tshig don rnams dgos kyang*/ bsgom don gyi ngag 'don rnams bzhag dkyus kyi tshig rnams ngag 'don dang bcas pa blang ngo*// de nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba la/ slob ma gcig nas gsum nyer lnga'i bar yan chad gang yin yang rung*/ khrus byas nas gral la 'khod pa la las slob kyis me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ de nas bla mas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du nyams len byin brlabs zab mo'i rim pa rnams gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pas gsan 'tshal/ 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nā ro ta pa chen pos gzhan la ma gnang ba'i pham thing pa sku mched la gnang ba'i gdams pa ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod ma dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa/ sman chen po'i bcud len/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba dang lnga yod pa las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod 'di nyid/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u bzhi bcu rtsa bdun par rnal 'byor ma'i nye snying la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs gsungs pa 'di nyid/ dpal nā ro ta pa chen pos bskyed rim zab mo mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs gsungs pa de nyid nyams su len pa la slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid sngar bshad pa dang ldan pas/ dus tshogs gsog par 'dod pas yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa sogs sgrib pa byang bar 'dod pas mar ngo'i tshes bcu la bya bar bshad pas/ de la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi las/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba/ mjug yon dbul ba dang gsum gyis bsdus pa las/ dang po la bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod pa/ bum pa bzlas pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/

gtor ma dang tshogs mchod dgos pa rnams legs par grub par bgyis so// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun gyis/ dad pa med pa'i sems kyis ni// legs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir bzlog ltar// dad pas bskrun pa'i sems kyis ni// phan pa'i sems kyis 'dir 'jug bya// zhes bshad pas/ 'dir lus sems rdo rje phag mor sngar yod pa byin rlabs zab mos ngo shes par byas nas nyams su len pa yin la/ de la bla ma dang yi dam la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa la/ bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus kyi nyams dang spyod pa de la nges shes bskyed nas/ de'i rgyun skyong ba yin pas/ mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa kun nas bslangs la maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa yon du phul nas/ snying gi dkyil rkang gi khong nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma'i mchog la bdag gsol 'debs// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas// bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ 'di rje btsun chen pos gsungs/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ bcug nas dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po la'ang gnyis las/ phyi'i 'jug pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa kun rdzob sin+dhu ra'i rten dang brten par shar ba/ ma rig pas sgrib nas ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir/ gdong ras yug dmar po re res bcing bar mos/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis bcing*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas me tog phreng ba'i phyag tu gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngar gyi sngags kyi gtad do// sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa 'phros byung ste/ byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/

ku shas chu bran/ sum+bha ni bzlas/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis lce la bzhag pa myang bas lus sems bde bas gang*/ nang gi bar chad thams cad dag par mos pa mdzod/ rigs dang 'dun pa dri bar gdags/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// theg pa chen po'i rigs can bde chen la 'dun zhing bde chen la dga' snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la'o// ched du bya ba nges pa'i phyir/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i lan du sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /de la nang gi sems bskyed mdzad dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sems can thams cad la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgrub/ de'i ched du rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems dung pa bskyed mdzod/ sems de khyed rang rnams yi dam du gsal pa'i thugs ka'i kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa re gsal lam gyis shar bar dung pa mdzod/ yang chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yin no snyam pas cung zad mi rtog pa'i ngang las mnyam par gzhog mdzod/ mnyam gzhag de las langs pas zla ba'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba gsal lam gyis shar bar mos pa mdzod/ de lta bu'i bden pa gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi/ de nas rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sogs ches gsang ba'i gnad 'di lta bu ni/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang*/ ldan yang ma dad pa la smrar mi rung zhes gdams par gda' ste/ deng khyod rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/

rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa 'di/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la ma yin no// slob dpon rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i phyag na gnas pa'i rdo rje la bzung ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i drung du sleb pa'i mos pa byas la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de rnams kyi phyi 'jug song*/ nang 'jug gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ thog ma med pa nas kun gzhi'i don gyi bag chags thams cad dang*/ sdom pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yi dam la ma dad ma gus pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la g.yel ba/ mchod pa dang gtor ma la mi brtson pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa 'jigs shing skrag pa/ gnong zhing 'gyod pas mi 'chab cing mi sbed cing slan chad bsdam pa'i sems kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar mthol bshags so snyam pa'i rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs gsum/ rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par so so'i dam tshig gi gong du spel snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs gsum brjod/ dam tshig gi sdom pa ma lus pa bzung zhing*/ khyad par du g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyi dam tshig ni/ spyir bud med la mi dmod pa dang*/ khyad par shes rab la ma brten pa'i dam tshig gi brgyad po bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpal mo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas pa// de yang tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*// lan gsum brjod/

dngos gzhi'i rim pa la/ bla ma rnal 'byor ma gsal ba dang*/ sin+dhu ra'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i yi dam lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ thog ma med nas las kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam smin sha rus kyi bar du sbyangs te/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar oṃ gsum mas bskor ba rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ de rnams 'od kyi rnam pas tshur 'dus/ yig 'bru rnams la thim yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar e las byung ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ dmar po/ chos 'byung gi grwa rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa re re yod par sgom mdzod/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon rin po ches bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku de dang de 'dra ba mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa dmar khril le ba re re byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas zhugs par mos pa mdzod/ ting lo mar me oṃ gsum mas khar bcug la gyur mid byed du gzhug de ltar zhal nas zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma 'di nyid/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs kyis yar khyug mar khyug mdzad/

mar lte ba'i bam̐ la thim/ de rnal 'byor ma'i skur krang nge gyur pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// rang nyid phyi'i rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor mos pa mdzod/ de nas lte ba'i dga' ba 'khyil ba rnams g.yon du 'khor ba las sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dkrol/ gu gul gyis bdug slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs par mos pa mdzod/ sngar bzhin sngags dang rol mo dang bdug pa rnams bya/ de ltar byin rlabs zhugs pas de nyid mi 'bral zhing brtan par bya ba'i phyir go cha'i sngags lan gcig brjod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ de ltar byin brlabs kyi myang ba cung zad gcig mnyam par bzhag bka' drin dran pas sngar bzhin gyi me tog rin po che'i phreng bar mos la/ de rnal 'byor ma'i dbu'am thugs kar phul bar mos la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod/ me tog phreng ba de sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis rlabs rnal 'byor mas rang gi mgo bor bzhag pas byin rlabs shin tu brtan par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la zhes brjod/ de ltar sems dang bam̐ lhan cig skyes pa'i phag mor ye nas gnas pa cho ga de dag gi gsal bar byas pas/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sgrib byed bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/

rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzod// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra n+ya tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ pa hrīḥ kye khyed rnams sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la gzigs par zhu lags te/ 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs par mos pa mdzod/ des dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song*/ gnyis pa bcug nas dbang bskur ba la dbang yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs rje btsun gsung*/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa'i mdun du/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs/ mtha' bskor du thod pa'i phreng bas bskor bas mchod pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lha mo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bum pa'i chu'i dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī hūm̐/ tsakra bi ra s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur nas/ dbang gi chu des rkang mthil yan chad gang bas dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ dbang lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ de ltar khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba de la bdag gis rab gnas byas par mos pa mdzod/ me tog 'thor/ oṃ su pra zhes brjod/ de la me tog sogs lngas mchod/

de ltar dbang thob nas bsgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blangs pa'i sgo nas mkha' spyod ma'i go 'phang grub dgos/ de la bzlas lung rjes gnang thob dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs kar bam̐ bsam/ rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa'i slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i bam̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba'i chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul gyis thol thol byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig gi mtha' skor du 'khod par mos la rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ de nas byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yi dam gyi lhar rnal 'byor ma bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum brjod/ me tog mgo bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di= bcom ldan 'di la= lan gsum brjod/ de nas sin+dha ra'i rdul tshon nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su thig le re bya/ oṃ gsum ma'am brjod/ sku'i dngos grub thams cad stsal zhing brtan par mos par mdzod/ de ltar rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i sgo nas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub stsal ba yin/ gsang dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le thod pa'i nang du lhung ba khyed rnams kyi ljags kyi steng na bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas oṃ gsum mas thig pa re re byin nas/ de ltar slob dpon gyi byang sems sbyin pa mgrin par myangs pas/ rtsa nang gi dam tshig pa dang thams cad 'dres pas/ lus thams cad bde stong gi nyams skyes par mos pa mdzod/

de ltar rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi sgo nas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi dngos grub stsal ba yin no// zhes rtogs pa skyes/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ khyed rang rnams rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang nas byin par mos pa mdzod/ bla mas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas blangs la oṃ gsum ma brjod cing*/ lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su mas yar thig le byas/ phyag len la bla ma'i g.yon gyi srin lag gi blangs la/ slob mas yang srin lag gis blangs la rang gis lte bar thig ler bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang du byin pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid lte bar drangs pas/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang*/ dga' ba'i nyams myong skyes/ de bzhin du snying gar drangs pas snying ga'i 'khor lo thams cad gang bas mchog dga'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ de bzhin du mgrin pa/ mgrin pa'i= dga' bral gyi ye shes= de bzhin du spyi= spyi bo'i= de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ byang chub kyi sems la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la stong pas khyab/ bde stong zung 'jug lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bar mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kyi sgo nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi dngos grub thob par mos pa mdzod/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bu dri med pa// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes pa'i don ni/ bden pa'i dngos po cung zad tsam ye nas yod ma myong ba la/

chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bya ba ni/ yod med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' dang bral ba nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu'i gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa'i dri mas ma gos pa dri ma med pa/ de lta bu'i stong pa nyid de yul can ye shes gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i rdo rje stong pa nyid du bsgoms/ zhes kyang bya/ de'i ngang la cung zad cig lhod de glod nas mnyam par gzhog mdzod/ de ltar na sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang dngos grub thob snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dam tshig dang sdom par bsrung bar khas blangs nas/ byin rlabs zab mo zhus pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar ma zad rang gi lus longs spyod kyi dngos po cha shas ji ltar rigs par longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs legs par thob pa yin/ thob nas kyang 'di'i bsgom bzlas chad med du nyams su len dgos/ bzlas pa'i grangs ci tsam bzla ba'i grangs re re nas dri/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len lugs dang bcas pa bshad des rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzod/ bsod nams 'di'i sogs bya/ slob ma rnams brje'o// bdag 'jug rjes 'dir tshogs dang 'brel ba gtor ma rnams lū dril ltar byin rlabs so so'i cho gas phul/ de nas tshogs mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la phud phul/ de nas gtor ma la cho ga so so'i sngags kyis phul/ de nas nang mchod kyang phyag len ltar phul/ rnal 'byor pa so so la yod na tshogs gzhung ltar ro// de nas mjug chog byed do// tshul 'di la mos pas tshes bcu la 'bad par 'dod pas rang gi brjed byang byas pa mkha' 'gro mas bzod par mdzad du gsol/
byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sa ma pa thā// ༈ /

nā ro pa'i thugs kyi snying khu sa skya pa'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa bzhin rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bya ba'i tshul rje kun dga' bzang po'i gsung bzhin gung rus zin mdzad pa bzhugs// ༈ /phyag 'tshal bla ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyis dge legs mdzod// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya ba dang*/ gnas skabs su mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang bsgrub/ de'i ched du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga zab mo zhu snyam pa'i bsam pas byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa sngon du btang nas gsan par zhu/ de yang rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas sku yang bud med gzugs can de// bud med gzugs kyi 'gro ba dag pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku nyid dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos shes rab ma'i rnam par sprul nas 'gro ba rnams 'dren par byed pa ste/ bdag med ma dang*/ phag mo la sogs pa'o// de'ang shes rab bdag med ma nyid phag mo'i tshul du bzung nas/ mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang ster ba yin zhing rnal 'byor ma la sgrub thabs kyis phye na/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ mai tri pa/ sha ba ri dbang phyug sogs kyis mdzad pa yod pa las/ 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo la nye snying gi sgo nas gsol ba btab nas mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang ster bar gsungs pa la brten nas/ dpal nā ro ta pas sgrub pa'i thabs mdzad pa 'di nyid nyams su len par byed do// spyir 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams nas rje btsun yab la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub pa/ de bzhin du yum la brten nas sgrub pa/ skye ba bdun pa'i sha la brten nas sgrub pa ste/ lugs mi 'dra ba gsum gsungs pa las/

'dir byin rlabs myur ba rje btsun yum la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs de nyid nyams su len par byed pa la/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ de yang sngon 'gro slob dpon bdag nyid lhar bskyed cing bzlas pa/ bum pa'i bzlas pa/ mdun du tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gsum sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i bar rnams byas te/ bdag 'jug byin rlabs kyi tshul du blangs pa sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi byin rlabs kyi cho ga zab mo sgrub par byed pa ste/ de yang ma rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba'am/ bye brag rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga zab mo zhu snyam pas/ maṇ+ḍal cig yon du phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen nas/ bzhugs su gsol/ lan gsum gdab/ sngon chad sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po re res gdong bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra a pa nā ya hūm̐ oṃ/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang mjal ba na phyag stong du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ me tog gi phreng ba re yang gtad par mos pa mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khyed rang rnams byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ las bum gyi chus slob ma rnams la gtor la/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po bsam ste/ zla ba kun rdzob byang chub sems dang*/

rdo rje don dam pa byang chub kyi sems 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin du sems bskyed pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ nas ya mi/ de dag brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra nas su khaṃ de lta bu'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i byin rlabs kyi kun spyod rnams skal ba dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed ces gdams pa ni/ rdo rje mgo por bzhag cing*/ deng khyod nas/ yang ma yin no// mdun gyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi drung du phyin te/ lho phyogs nas zhugs par mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dza hūm̐/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la sdom pa bzung ba'i ched du phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi nas/ pad la 'dud kyis bar dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de dag spyan sngar skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ sdig pa bshags pa/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi sdom pa bzung ba/ lam brtan par dam bca' ba'i 'dun pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog nas/ 'grub par shog lan gsum/ sras bcas nas/ 'das la 'god/ lan gsum/ dbang bskur ba'i dus su legs par thob pa'i dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa rnams sor chud cing brtan par bya ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'khor lo bde mchog thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang nas/ legs par bzung*/ lan gsum/ dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag blang bar mos pa mdzod/ de dag gi sngon 'gro rgyud sbyang ba'i cho ga byas nas dngos gzhi de'i ye shes pa bdag la 'jug pa'i phyir du ye shes dbab pa yin te/

gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug bam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs gnyis med ye shes spyan drangs bam̐ yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i gnas rnams su nas/ tsaṇ+ḍa ka'i ngo bo/ yang na khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi grwa rnams su/ dga' ba 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bam̐ yig gi mtha' bskor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ nas swā hā/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar lus thams cad la khyab pas/ rang gi lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ tshe 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyon mongs pa rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i phung khams skye mched du 'dzin pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ slar 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ de nyid du thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo sogs sngar bzhin bskyed nas go cha dgod pa sngar dang 'dra ste/ gnyis po 'dam kha can no//

de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi phaiṃ zhes brjod/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams la thim/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga nas/ shud+dho3haṃ/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pho nya gsum gyi rang bzhin/ de nyid brtan par mdzad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la gus 'dud drag po byas te/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu'i sogs/ slob dpon khyed kyis bdag la sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun gyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa tshad med grangs med mar me'i phreng ba'am/ 'ol mo se'i phreng ba ltar dmar na ra ra byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud lte bar byon pa chos 'byung dmar po sang nge ba'i nang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam zhig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rtsa dag pa'i lam dbu ma nas brgyud de lte bar chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba bsam pa'i dbus su dang po de zhugs/ phyi ma rnams de la thim pas rnal 'byor ma'i sku bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gar stabs dang ldan pa la sems gtad/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing*/ mar me 'bar bzhin pa slob ma'i khar bcug cing mid du bzhugs/ yang gong gi mdun bskyed kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bde ba sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin gar mdzad pa cig dmigs nas/ de la shes pa hril gyis gtad pa'i ngang nas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/

yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs nas/ khyed rang rnam pa'i sku lus la thim/ de dang dus mnyam du mdun gyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnam pa'i sku lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ ḍā dril res 'jog lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad la khyab pas lus kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems g.yo nas/ drod kyis bsdus pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par mos shing*/ lte bar shes pa hril gyis gtad/ de las byung ba'i ye shes gnyis ma brjed par byas nas lam du bsre dgos pa yin yang khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su chos 'byung gru gsum dmar seng nge ba'i nang du/ ngo bo dga' ba'i rang bzhin 'khyil par gnas pa ste/ g.yon bskor du 'khyil li li 'khor ba la shes pa gtad pas/ gsang gnas kyi rtsa dbu ma kha phye ste der rlung 'dus pas/ bde ba chen po'i rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril yang smin mtshams su chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba'i nang du/ dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po g.yon du 'khor ba la shes pa smin mtshams su chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba'i nang du/ dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po g.yon du 'khor ba la shes pa gtad pas/ dbu ma'i yas sna kha phye ste/ der rlung sems 'dus pas chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid chos kyi dbyings kyi rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril de nyid las byung ba'i nyams rnams ngos bzung ste ma brjed par byas nas kyang lam du bsrel dgos pa yin no// khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyag tu bzung ba'i me tog de nyid traṃ las byung pa'i rin po che'i 'phreng bar mos la/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi drung du byon te sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rje gcig nyid gdul bya sna tshogs kyi dbang gis shes rab ma'i gzugs kyi rnam par snang ba yin gyi rang gi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/ rang gi rigs kyi lha'i spyi bor bab par shog cig snyam pa'i bsam pas/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod de me tog dor mdzod/ pra ti gṛh+na s+t+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ brjod cing lag tu gtad cing gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de nas kye rdo rje ltos shig ces lta bar bskul ba yin te/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor sum rim gyi 'og gi 'di nyid sku tshom bu'i ri mo'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i gsang ba mtshon byed yin te/ grwa drug rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang drug gi rang bzhin yin/ rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas 'dren par byed/ de'i steng na gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi gsang ba mtshon byed yin/ de'i steng na thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor thugs kyi gsang ba mtshon byed/ mdor na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mtshon byed yin/ phyi rol du de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang du bkod pa de yin/ thugs kyi gsang ba mtshon byed/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid nang rnal 'byor ma'i lus la bkod na/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dang pos gsang gnas/ gnyis pa lte ba gru gsum gyi rang bzhin de gnyis kyi dbu ma'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de nyid zlum po snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/

de'i steng na bam̐ yig dmar po/ phyogs bzhir ya ra la wa g.yon skor du yod pa mgrin pa longs spyod/ bam̐ yig gi mthar yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ de ltar bkod cing gnad du bsnun tshul de yin/ de la bsten nas zag med kyi dga' ba bcu drug skye ba/ de gnyis mdun rgyab gnyis ma gtogs pa'i grwa bzhi'i dga' ba 'khyil pa bzhi ste/ dga' ba 'khyil pa bzhi pa la'ang*/ dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bcu drug nyams su myang ba de nyid mtshon par byed/ de'i dbus na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa ste/ de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs shing rten pa la brten/ ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa las skyob cing*/ mkha' spyod kyi grong du 'khrid par byed de dkyil 'khor bstan pa yin/ de rnams sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i chos rnams song ste/ 'jug pa'i cho ga mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin/ sngar dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba legs pa 'thob nas byin brlabs kyi tshad du 'jug pa 'di tsam gyis chog par gyur pa yin no// dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin brlabs kyi tshul du len pa yin te/ de'i ched du maṇ+ḍal zhig yon du phul/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ rnal 'byor ma dpal nas/ stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su dbang stegs kyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ de'i gnas rnams su nas/ tsaṇ+ḍa ka'i ngo bo ste/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis phaiṃ zhes brjod cing thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes brjod khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba'i ched du spyan drangs/ de thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi'i rdo rje glu len/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li la sogs pa dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mtshams dril bya zhing*/ he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi klad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e wam̐ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li ka lī gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ gyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// rgyun chags su bsal bsil zhing*/ nyin mo nas/ deng 'dir stsol zhes brjod cing me tog dor/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phye ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dkar po yal 'dab dang bcas pa cung zad yo bar 'dzin bzhin pas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni nas/ chen po sbyin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi nas/ s+t+waṃ tsakra bi ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi ka ka se nas/ ma tha n+ya badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad nas/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa de bum pa'i dbang byin brlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba yin/ nam mkha' khyab par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams rang la thim par mos pa mdzod/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin te/ slob dpon rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du bam̐ yig de las sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du bam̐ yig bsam pa la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ swā hā/ lan gsum sngags kyis byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dus da nas bzung nas byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan nas/ slob dpon gyis me tog mgo bor bzhag cing*/ bcom ldan 'di la nas/ byin gyis rlobs/ de nas 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga thob phyin chad bzlas bsgom ma chags par byas pa tsam gyis ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba'i g.yang sa las skyabs/ lus ma spangs par tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mkhrig ma nas bzung ste mkha' spyod dga' ma'i zhing du 'khrid par byed do// bsod nams 'bring du gyur pa yin na laṅka li ya dang*/ sin+dhu ra'i bsgrub pa sngags kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pa'i sgo nas bsgrubs pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi'i bu mo'i rnam pa can dpral bar sha'i dga' ba 'khyil ba yod pa lta bu dang 'phrad nas mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed/ bsod nams tha ma yin na bsgom bzlas ma chags par byas pa la brten nas bar dor 'grub pas rjes su 'dzin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus 'di bor bas sems de nyid bar do'i g.yang las skyabs nas mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed la/ de la da lta nas bzlas bsgom ma chags par byed dgos pa yin pas/ khyed ji tsam bgrongs zhes dris te/

brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam bgrongs byas pas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mchog bsgrub pa'i yi dam du bcas te/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du nyi ma re re bzhin/ snying po oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam khas blangs ma chags par bzla bar dam bca' lags so// zhes brjod du gzhug nas rig pa yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di rnams la/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i byin rlabs thams cad gcig char du 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba'i g.yang sa las skyabs nas mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor/ sngags gtad pa'i cho ga'o// gsang dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du dbang bskur ba yin te/ mdun gyi thod pa'i nang du yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rnam pa de nyid/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ ha ho hrīḥzhes brjod pas byin tshar ba dang yang dag par sba bar gyur pa de nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi khar sgor btab pa la brten nas/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ kra ma'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing bdud rtsi mdun gyi thod pa'i nang nas/ kha sgor btab pa de nyid lce la myangs shing mgrin par mid pa la brten nas/ yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i rtog pa 'gags te/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang gsum pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul du bskur ba la/ mdun gyi sin+dhu ra la yi ge sum cu bkod cing bris pa dang*/ grwa'i dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ rdul mtshon dmar po me rdul gyi rnam par gyur pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar dang*/
mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga dang*/ lte ba rnams su slob dpon gyis g.yon pa'i srin lag gis bskus pa la brten nas/ de rnams kyi thad kyi nang gi 'khor lo so so'i

gtum mo'i me sbar nas/ byang sems dwangs ma zhu ba la brten nas/ phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las 'byung ba'i bde ba de lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing bskus te/ mdun gyi sin+dhu ra nas rdul mtshon dmar po me 'od sbar ba'i rnam par gyur pa nas/ me 'bar te de dang de'i byang sems dwangs ma nas mdzod la/ de'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu nas/ ko3haṃ/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang byin brlabs kyi tshul gyis bskur ba yin/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bu dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid ni bsgom pa bgyi// zhes gsungs pa'i don yang gong du byin brlabs byas pa la brten nas/ lus sems bde ba chen po'i rnam par shar ba de nyid/ rang gi ngo bo la bltas na spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin/ gang du'ang ma grub cing*/ dpe dang gtan tshig la sogs pa brjod pa dang bral ba/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid de kho na nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid yin la/ de ltar spros pa dang bral yang bde ba chen po'i rnam pa mi 'gog lus sems bde chen gyi rang bzhin du shar yang*/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la ma 'das/ de'i ngang la sems cham me gzhog mdzod/ de nyid bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi lam du bsgrubs pa la brten nas kyang rtogs par 'gyur ba yin/ de dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba'o// des dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du legs par thob/ lam bskyed rim nā ro mkha' spyod/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu mar rlung sems 'jug pa'i gdams ngag bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ de'i khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa nas/ bgyi/ lan gsum/ de ltar nā ro mkha' spyod ces bya ba'i sgrub thabs la mtshan du btags pa/ grub chen nā ro pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed mkhan gyi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal cig yon du dbul/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma la phul nas cha shas kyis bzhes su gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nas/ gsol/ lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la phul bar mos pa mdzad par zhu/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga rdzogs par bgyis pas/ des rang gzhan gyi don mthar phyin pa mdzad par zhu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs smon lam btab bo// rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po ā nan+da bha dra ngor chen kun dga' bzang po 'i gsung las ji ltar zin pa tsam zhig pra dz+nyā bha dra gung ru shes rab bzang po sa brjed byang du bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
